name: Trust core
purpose: every request is authenticated, authorised, rate-limited, traced and audited before any feature exists.
exit_gate: audit chain verifier passes; log-redaction test finds no secret; every method rejects without role, scope or plan.
traps: RLS must be the second check, never the only one; do not skip the gateway check because RLS exists.
note: `passes` is set only by CI after a task's acceptance tests pass there. Dependencies default to the previous task in the phase; loosen them when tasks are independent. Areas are a first guess; one agent per area at a time.

tasks.title: Gateway: WSS JSON-RPC 2.0, protocol version check at connect, method table with role, scope and plan declarations, typed errors, idempotency keys with stored first results.
spec_refs: README: Gateway and request path, Security model (Secrets, Audit, Approval tiers), Data model, API (rules).
acceptance: every method rejects without the declared role, scope and plan (generated test per method); idempotent replays return the first result; audit verifier detects a changed, deleted or inserted row; log-redaction test injects known secrets everywhere and finds none in logs or traces.
